# Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress

MAUI host: UseMvvmExpress, MauiMainThread, page lifecycle. Depends on Core.

NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
Docs: https://nuvyntralabs.github.io/packages/plugin-maui-mvvmexpress/
Catalog: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/MauiEssentials
License: MIT
Version: 0.6.0-preview (`--prerelease`)

## Supported versions

net10.0, net10.0-android (API 21+), net10.0-ios (iOS 15+). Mac Catalyst / Windows compile-only.

## Installation

dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress --prerelease

Registration: `builder.UseMvvmExpress()`.

## Use this package when

- A MAUI Android/iOS app already uses Core ViewModels and needs the host dispatcher and lifecycle behavior

## Do not use when

- The project is `net10.0` tests only — use Core + `AddMvvmExpress()`
- They need Shell/page navigation or alerts/toasts — add Navigation / Dialogs packages

## Alternatives

CommunityToolkit.Maui (behaviors), Prism.Maui (bootstrapper).
